items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I had an aunt that just recently passed. She was a twin; her name was Agnes - I mean, was Mattie.

ctx.x: That's most interesting. What is your first recollection of your great interest in music? When did you first begin to get a feeling for music, an interest?
I had an aunt that just recently passed. She was a twin; her name was Agnes - I mean, was Mattie. This is on my mother's side of the family of about 9 children approximately.
